title: Parts and Accessories
shortDescription: Drilling Accessories and Parts are essential components used in various drilling operations, particularly in industries like construction, mining, oil, and gas.
contentList: Drill Bits – The cutting tool used to penetrate surfaces.
Drill Pipes and Rods – Transfer power from surface equipment.
Shank Adapters – Connect the drill bit to the machine.
Blowout Preventers (BOPs) – Safety devices for uncontrolled releases.
Couplings - Connect two joints of casing or rods.

title: Maintenance and Service
shortDescription: Maintenance and Service are crucial for keeping equipment in optimal working condition, minimizing downtime, and ensuring efficiency.
contentList: Preventive Maintenance – Tasks to prevent breakdowns.
redictive Maintenance – Predict failures using data.
